title: How Do AI Agents Spend Your Money? Analyzing and Predicting Token Consumption in Agentic Coding Tasks
authors_or_org: Longju Bai, Zhemin Huang, Xingyao Wang, Jiao Sun, Rada Mihalcea, Erik Brynjolfsson, Alex Pentland, Jiaxin Pei
supported_claim: Eight-model OpenHands/SWE-bench Verified study with four runs per task reports stochastic token consumption, input-driven cost, weak human-difficulty alignment, and weak-to-moderate pre-execution self-prediction with underestimation.
limitations: Benchmark, harness and model selection are not enterprise population validation; self-prediction is not the same estimator as a supervised aggregate forecast. Observational token/success association is not causal effect of extra budget.
license_status: Paper HTML explicitly states CC BY 4.0; dataset/code licenses not verified here.

title: TraceLab: Characterizing Coding Agent Workloads for LLM Serving
authors_or_org: Kan Zhu, Mathew Jacob, Chenxi Ma, Yi Pan, Stephanie Wang, Arvind Krishnamurthy, Baris Kasikci
supported_claim: Real developer logs have session/request/step hierarchy, human-paced gaps, context growth and reductions, imperfect caching, and long-tailed tool latency. Table 1 reports 4,265 sessions, 43 developers and 357,161 steps, with costs as estimated API list-price equivalents.
limitations: Researchers' day-to-day workflow sample; not representative enterprise billing or general agent domains. Provider internals and causal caching mechanisms unobserved. Public data does not provide this company's financial or planning context.

title: TraceLab public dataset and toolkit repository
authors_or_org: University of Washington SyFI Lab / uw-syfi
published_or_version: Repository README snapshot 2026-10-24 identifies public dataset v0.0.1; extractor/schema commit not pinned in research stage
supported_claim: Public metadata, separate code/data licenses and dataset v0.0.1 are documented. README also documents late Codex usage reports and CLI/turn-ID-dependent result association: a normalized row is not wholly available at its first timestamp.
limitations: No dataset downloaded or experiment executed. Pin asset/checksum separately from extractor/schema. Field-level availability is required for prefix replay; without original ingestion history label event-time simulation, not preserved real arrival/source-delay replay. No enterprise billing truth.
license_status: README explicitly states code Apache License 2.0 and public trace dataset CC BY 4.0.

title: Measuring AI agent autonomy in practice
supported_claim: Autonomous turn duration is confounded by task difficulty, user oversight, product speed and concurrency; public API requests cannot reliably be grouped into sessions, unlike the provider's own Claude Code telemetry.
limitations: Provider-selected usage; autonomy and human intervention endpoints are not spending-forecast accuracy. Changing user composition complicates time trends. No universal time-to-token conversion.
license_status: Reuse license not verified; cite and paraphrase only.

title: Coding agents ignore their own budgets
supported_claim: GPT-5.4/mini-swe-agent budget experiment reports no observable effect of passive budget prompts; balanced 100-task controller evaluation separates work from continuation approval, including oracle-information conditions.
limitations: Control under a specific utility and selected balanced tasks, not forecasting validation. Article prose about near-universal approval by four controllers conflicts with displayed class accuracies. Oracle-probability success demonstrates decision arithmetic with supplied information, not estimation.
license_status: Reuse license not verified; cite and paraphrase only.

title: BAGEN: Are LLM Agents Budget-Aware?
authors_or_org: Yuxiang Lin, Zihan Wang, Mengyang Liu, Yuxuan Shan, Longju Bai, Junyao Zhang, Xing Jin, Boshan Chen, Jinyan Su, Xingyao Wang, Jiaxin Pei, Manling Li
supported_claim: Rollout-prefix remaining-budget interval evaluation distinguishes feasibility, early failure recognition and calibration; tested frontier models show optimistic errors and limited interval calibration.
limitations: Four environments and five agents; eventual resources/feasibility rather than enterprise horizon increments or future arrival forecasts. Offline replay does not establish effects under a changed live execution policy.
license_status: Paper HTML explicitly states CC BY 4.0; dataset/code licenses not verified here.

title: Beyond Token Savings: A Systematic Study of Context Compression in LLM Agents
authors_or_org: Ritul Satish, Prasoon Sinha, Akiho Kawada, Neeraja J. Yadwadkar
supported_claim: Across almost 35,000 runs with three open-weight models and two coding benchmarks, compression affects behavior and token reductions need not imply lower latency or estimated cost.
limitations: Benchmark and model/policy-specific findings; estimated costs do not establish billed enterprise savings or a universal compaction effect.
license_status: Paper HTML explicitly states CC BY 4.0; experimental artifact licenses not verified here.

title: Using Time Dependent Covariates and Time Dependent Coefficients in the Cox Model
authors_or_org: Terry Therneau, Cynthia Crowson, Elizabeth Atkinson / Mayo Clinic
published_or_version: Document dated 2026-01-12; R-devel survival documentation snapshot
supported_claim: Time-dependent survival analysis encodes intervals and risk sets using covariates available before an event; using future outcomes in covariates introduces invalid look-ahead.
limitations: Methodological source, not validation of a survival model for coding sessions. Informative missingness and population assumptions must be checked in the proposed application.
license_status: PDF-specific reuse license not verified; no code copied.

title: Hawkes Processes
authors_or_org: Patrick J. Laub, Thomas Taimre, Philip K. Pollett
supported_claim: Hawkes processes represent self-excitation in event arrival intensity; establishes mathematical model class, not suitability for coding demand.
limitations: No coding-agent workload evidence; apparent clustering can reflect omitted common causes or measurement artifacts. Use as a candidate only after residual diagnostics and baseline comparison.
license_status: Reuse license not verified; cite and paraphrase only.
